run_evaluation_on_human_data: run evaluation of a fine-tuned model on human annotation data using FairscoreTrainerEvalOnly
run_main_function: run the main function to evaluate a model on unperturbed human evaluation dataset
run_fairscore_trainer_eval: run FairscoreTrainerEvalOnly to evaluate model predictions on a perturbed dataset with metrics
run_dataset_loading: run load_and_format_dataset to prepare and tokenize the human evaluation dataset for assessment
run_compute_metrics: run compute_metrics to calculate evaluation metrics for regression or classification tasks
